tasks.objective_text_en: King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem wants you to collect 8 Horn Fragments from Thunderfall.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：雷暴台地的号角碎片五号分别拾取，以最低号8/8为离开条件。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：《回首往事》号角碎片五号分别拾取。

tasks.name: 亡者的纪念碑
tasks.objective_text_zh: 约库姆国王要求你将号角碎片交给丹尼芬雷的亚米尔德。
tasks.objective_text_en: King Jokkum wants you to bring Hodir's Horn Fragments to Njormeld in Dun Niffelem.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 霍迪尔的呼唤
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往落雷谷，击败5名尼芬雷先祖和5名永不疲倦的霜脉矮人，并对他们的尸体吹响霍迪尔的号角。然后将霍迪尔的号角带回丹尼芬雷。
tasks.objective_text_en: You are to defeat 5 Niffelem Forefathers and 5 Restless Frostborn at Thunderfall. You are then to blow Hodir's Horn over their corpses, then return to Hodir's Horn in Dun Niffelem.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 进攻尼达维里尔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布德克拉格庇护所的布鲁沃·斩铁要你前往尼达维里尔，杀死10个雷铸铁矮人的士兵。雷铸勇士、雷铸大法师或雷铸作战魔像都可以。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge wants you to kill 10 Nidavelir Stormforged. You may kill Stormforged Champions, Stormforged Magi, or Stormforged War Golems.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 雷铸勇士/大法师/作战魔像合计10只；打作战魔像时留意黑暗护甲板触发物。

tasks.name: 黑暗的护甲板
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将4份黑暗护甲板样品交给布德克拉格庇护所的布鲁沃·斩铁。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 4 Dark Armor Samples to Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：黑暗护甲板一旦掉落，同一具作战魔像五号都可分别拾取并接任务；后续4份黑暗护甲样品进度共享。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《黑暗的护甲板》起始护甲板同一尸体五号可分别拾取，后续4份黑暗护甲样品进度共享。

tasks.name: 护甲板的秘密
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把黑暗护甲板带到米米尔的车间去，让随从托克检查它。完成任务后，向布德克拉格庇护所的布鲁沃·斩铁复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Dark Armor Plate to Mimir's Workshop and ask Attendant Tock to examine it. When you're finished, return to Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：护甲板的秘密只需与随从托克互动一次，五号同步完成。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《护甲板的秘密》只需互动一次。

tasks.name: 热与冷
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往霜原湖，消灭脆弱的亡魂，并对冒烟的碎片使用冰之精华。收集6块冻铁碎片，将它们带回丹尼芬雷的弗约恩之砧。
tasks.objective_text_en: You are to go to Frostfield Lake, kill the Brittle Revenants there and use the Essence of Ice on the Smoldering Scraps at Fjorn's Anvil. You are then to collect 6 of the Frozen Iron scraps and return to Fjorn's Anvil in Dun Niffelem.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：每号先杀怪取得6份任务道具，再分别使用6次并拾取后续目标物；与霜原湖当前任务顺路完成。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：《热与冷》每号分别取得6份任务道具、使用6次并拾取后续目标物。

tasks.name: 最后的母熊
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布伦希尔达村的艾丝崔·约利塔尔要你去冬眠洞穴解救一头冰喉母熊。
tasks.objective_text_en: Astrid Bjornrittar in Brunnhildar Village wants you to rescue an Icemaw Matriarch in the Hibernal Cavern.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 风暴之子瓦杜兰
tasks.objective_text_zh: 当你发现风暴之子瓦杜兰时，使用布德克拉格的作战号角。击败风暴之子瓦杜兰，然后回到布德克拉格庇护所，向塑石者布德克拉格复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use Bouldercrag's War Horn when you have found Valduran the Stormborn. Defeat Valduran the Stormborn and return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 雷铸徽记
tasks.objective_text_zh: 丹尼芬雷的亚米尔德要求你前往霜原湖，对那一带的死亡的铁巨人使用钻石尖锄，收集8枚雷铸徽记，然后回去向他复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Njormeld in Dun Niffelem needs you to use the Diamond Tipped Pick on the Dead Iron Giants at Frostfield Lake and return to him when you have collected 8 Stormforged Eyes.

extra_objectives.text: Use Diamond Tipped Pick on the corpses of Dead Iron Giants

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：同一具死亡铁巨人只能挖一次；谁用钻石尖镐，直接出的雷铸之眼归谁。若刷出伏击者，其掉落也按普通怪个人掉落处理，收齐各号8只眼。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：同一死亡铁巨人只能挖一次；直接出的眼睛归挖取角色，伏击者掉落按普通怪个人掉落。

tasks.name: 泰坦的命运
tasks.objective_text_zh: 山底平原的克莱特乌斯要求你前往创世神殿、寒冬神殿、生命神殿和秩序神殿，并使用数据库探查这些区域。
tasks.objective_text_en: Creteus in the Foot Steppes has requested that you travel to the Temple of Invention, the Temple of Winter, the Temple of Life, and the Temple of Order and utilize the databank to examine each area.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 放置霍迪尔之盔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 亚米尔德要求你飞到丹尼芬雷北边的冰柱顶端，并在那里使用宣告石板。
tasks.objective_text_en: Njormeld wants you to fly to the tip of the northern ice spike in Dun Niffelem and use the Tablets of Pronouncement.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：丹尼芬雷北侧约(64.2,59.2)矮冰柱顶端使用宣告石板，五号分别操作。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：宣告石板五号分别使用。

tasks.name: 摧毁熔炉！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用布德克拉格的炸弹摧毁北部闪电熔炉、中部闪电熔炉和南部闪电熔炉，然后回到布德克拉格庇护所，向塑石者布德克拉格复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Destroy the North Lightning Forge, the Central Lightning Forge, and the South Lightning Forge with Bouldercrag's Bombs, then return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：北/中/南三个闪电熔炉由主控各投弹一次即可同步五号。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《摧毁熔炉！》三座熔炉主控完成即可。

tasks.name: 黑暗的冰虫
tasks.objective_text_zh: 艾丝崔·约利塔尔要你到布伦希尔达村东边的冬眠洞穴去，杀死8条饥饿的冰虫。
tasks.objective_text_en: Astrid Bjornrittar wants you to slay 8 Ravenous Jormungar in the Hibernal Cavern east of Brunnhildar Village.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 冬眠洞穴入口在地面左侧、任务区域尖角处，约(55.9,63.9)。

tasks.name: 正中要害
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死10名雷铸技师，然后返回布德克拉格庇护所，向布鲁沃·斩铁复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 10 Stormforged Artificers and return to Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 巨像的威胁
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到巨像攻击规格说明书和巨像防御规格说明书，并把它们交给布德克拉格庇护所的塑石者布德克拉格。
tasks.objective_text_en: Retrieve the Colossus Attack Specs and Colossus Defense Specs and bring them to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：攻击/防御规格说明书在尼达维里尔下层固定位置；同一刷新点可五号连续拾取。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：两份规格说明书可同一刷新点五号连续拾取。

tasks.name: 猎杀间谍
tasks.objective_text_zh: 击败上古寒冬山谷中的3名雷铸间谍。 /  / 对座狼的尸体使用灵体座狼之牙，召唤出一只灵体冰霜座狼，帮助你找出隐藏的敌人。完成任务之后向丹尼芬雷的冰霜座狼母兽复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: You must defeat 3 Stormforged Spies in the Valley of Ancient Winters. /  / Using the Ethereal Worg's Fang at the Corpse of the Fallen Worg will summon an Ethereal Frostworg, which will expose hidden enemies. You are to return to the Frostworg Denmother in Dun Niffelem when the valley has been cleansed of spies.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：对座狼尸体使用灵体座狼之牙召唤灵体冰霜座狼，跟随找到并击杀雷铸间谍；每次击杀后回尸体重新召唤，共3次，主控完成即可同步五号。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《猎杀间谍》进度五号同步。

tasks.name: 热身赛
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布伦希尔达村的艾丝崔·约利塔尔要你使用冰喉母熊的缰绳打败基加拉格。
tasks.objective_text_en: Astrid Bjornrittar in Brunnhildar Village wants you to use the Reins of the Warbear Matriarch to defeat Kirgaraak.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：在布伦希尔达南侧使用冰喉母熊缰绳，由主控打败基加拉格即可同步五号。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《热身赛》基加拉格只需主控骑熊完成一次。

tasks.name: 进入利齿之坑
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布伦希尔达村的艾丝崔·约利塔尔要你在利齿之坑里使用冰喉母熊的缰绳，并打败6头海德比武会战熊。
tasks.objective_text_en: Astrid Bjornrittar, in Brunnhildar Village, wants you to use the Reins of the Warbear Matriarch inside the Pit of the Fang and defeat 6 Hyldsmeet Warbears.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：在利齿之坑使用冰喉母熊缰绳，由主控完成6头海德比武会战熊即可同步五号。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《进入利齿之坑》6头海德比武会战熊由主控完成即可同步五号。

tasks.name: 风暴之心
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布德克拉格庇护所的塑石者布德克拉格希望你前往奥迪斯，尝试阻止纳维尔获取风暴之心。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge wants you to travel to Uldis and try to prevent Overseer Narvir from obtaining the Heart of the Storm.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：奥迪斯入口在山体南侧约(32.4,63.8)，可直接飞入；进洞后继续向里，从地板裂口下降，风暴之心约(36.1,60.9)，一号互动即可同步。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《风暴之心》一号互动即可同步。

tasks.name: 紧急措施
tasks.objective_text_zh: 血卫士洛尔加要你前往东边的基莫拉克之巢，收集6张座狼的毛皮。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bloodguard Lorga wants you to go to the Gimorak's Den to the east and obtain 6 Worg Furs.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 基莫拉克之巢洞口约(46.7,55.2)；冰原狼主要在洞内，和《失踪的猎人》同一趟收齐6张狼皮。

tasks.name: 打造霍迪尔之矛
tasks.objective_text_zh: 丹尼芬雷的博学者兰德维尔要求你前往冬眠洞穴收集3块永冻碎片，并从上古寒冬山谷的坚韧猛犸象身上收集3块坚韧猛犸象的毛皮。
tasks.objective_text_en: Lorekeeper Randvir in Dun Niffelem wants you to collect 3 Everfrost Shards from the depths of Hibernal Cavern and 3 Stoic Mammoth Hides from the Stoic Mammoths in the Valley of Ancient Winters.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：五号分别取3块永冻碎片和3张坚韧猛犸象毛皮；永冻碎片同一刷新位置可连续给多个角色拾取。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：永冻碎片和猛犸象毛皮五号分别收集；同一永冻碎片刷新位置可连续拾取。

tasks.name: 屠龙记
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用霍迪尔之矛挑衅上古寒冬山谷的野生巨龙，然后与它决一死战。
tasks.objective_text_en: You are to use Hodir's Spear to challenge a Wild Wyrm in the Valley of Ancient Winters. Once in its grip, you are to fight to the death.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 土灵的誓言
tasks.objective_text_zh: 造物者圣台的托里姆要求你使用峭壁号角召集土灵，并打败20个铁矮人和7个铁哨兵。
tasks.objective_text_en: Thorim, at the Terrace of the Makers, wants you to use the Horn of the Peaks and call on the Earthen to defeat 20 Iron Dwarves and 7 Iron Sentinels.

extra_objectives.text: Use the Horn of the Peaks and call on the Earthen to defeat Iron Dwarves and Iron Sentinels

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：先用峭壁号角召土灵援军，再由主控完成击杀目标即可同步五号。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《土灵的誓言》进度同步。

tasks.name: 粘滞清洁
tasks.objective_text_zh: 进入丹尼芬雷以西的冬眠洞穴，从粘性油污身上收集5份粘性油。 /  / 然后返回丹尼芬雷，将油涂在霍迪尔的头盔上。
tasks.objective_text_en: You are to enter Hibernal Cavern west of Dun Niffelem and collect 5 units of Viscous Oil from the Viscous Oils there. /  / You are then to return to Dun Niffelem and apply the oil to Hodir's Helm.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：五号分别完成《粘滞清洁》；目标怪刷新很快，有人抢怪时原地等刷新即可，不必换点绕圈。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：《粘滞清洁》五号分别拾取；目标怪刷新很快，可原地等刷新。

tasks.name: 钢铁巨像
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用被驯服的冰虫击败钢铁巨像，然后回到布德克拉格庇护所，向塑石者布德克拉格复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use a Tamed Jormungar to defeat the Iron Colossus and return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

extra_objectives.text: Mount Tamed Jormungar to fight Iron Colossus

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 五号一起骑被驯服的冰虫打钢铁巨像更稳；单号容易翻车。不要下坐骑直接硬打。

tasks.name: 新的开始
tasks.objective_text_zh: 亚米尔德要求你将重铸的风暴之王铠甲交给风暴神殿的托里姆。
tasks.objective_text_en: Njormeld wants you to take the Reforged Armor to Thorim at the Temple of Storms.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 科洛米尔，风暴之锤
tasks.objective_text_zh: 托里姆要你与丹尼芬雷的约库姆国王谈一谈，向他打听科洛米尔的消息。
tasks.objective_text_en: Thorim wants you to talk to King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem and discover what he knows of Krolmir.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 斩除尤卡塔尔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 丹尼芬雷的约库姆国王要求你前往冬眠洞穴，杀死尤卡塔尔。
tasks.objective_text_en: King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem wants you to slay Jorcuttar in Hibernal Cavern.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：只需准备1块冰喉熊肉，在刷新点放肉引出尤卡塔尔并击杀一次即可同步五号。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《斩除尤卡塔尔》只需准备1块冰喉熊肉并诱引击杀一次。

tasks.name: 见证者与英雄
tasks.objective_text_zh: 唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔希望你去阅读第一份历史卷轴、第二份历史卷轴和第三份历史卷轴。
tasks.objective_text_en: Xarantaur, at Camp Tunka'lo, wants you to read the First History Scroll, the Second History Scroll, and the Third History Scroll.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：唐卡洛营地内3份历史卷轴五号分别交互；同一卷轴可五号连续各自点击。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：《见证者与英雄》3份历史卷轴五号分别交互；同一卷轴可连续各自点击。

tasks.name: 洛肯的副官
tasks.objective_text_zh: 托里姆要你杀死塑造者之厅的伊森法斯、造物者圣台的风之哈勒弗尼尔和符文巨人杜洛恩。
tasks.objective_text_en: Thorim wants you to slay Eisenfaust inside the Hall of the Shaper and Halefnir the Windborn and Duronn the Runeforged in the Terrace of the Makers.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：伊森法斯约(55.3,43.3) → 风之哈勒弗尼尔约(48.7,45.7) → 符文巨人杜洛恩约(44.9,38.0)，三个副官各击杀一次即可同步。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《洛肯的副官》三个副官各杀一次。

tasks.name: 雷蹄的记忆
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与浮冰深渊的迅矛酋长谈一谈，然后返回唐卡洛营地，向夏拉托尔复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Chieftain Swiftspear in Frostfloe Deep, then return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 时间的扰动
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用酋长的图腾封闭4道浮冰裂隙，然后将图腾还给唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Chieftain's Totem to close 4 Frostfloe Rifts, then bring the totem to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：拿到图腾后，到浮冰深渊南侧封闭4道裂隙；主控完成即可同步五号。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《时间的扰动》4道浮冰裂隙由主控封闭即可同步五号。

tasks.name: 喂饱安格里姆
tasks.objective_text_zh: 让安格里姆吞食5条灵体冰虫，然后返回丹尼芬雷，向安格里姆的冰冻躯体复命。 /  / 你必须前往上古寒冬山谷，对游荡的冰虫使用安格里姆之牙。一旦它们脱离肉体，就与灵体形态的冰虫进行战斗，直到它们变得虚弱。
tasks.objective_text_en: You are to feed Arngrim 5 Disembodied Jormungar, then return to Arngrim's frozen image in Dun Niffelem. /  / You must go to the Valley of Ancient Winters and use Arngrim's Tooth on the Roaming Jormungar there. Once they have become disembodied, you must fight them until they are weakened.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：对游荡的冰虫使用安格里姆之牙，再把灵体冰虫打到虚弱让安格里姆吞食；共5只，主控完成一轮即可同步五号。不要把目标直接打死。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《喂饱安格里姆》进度五号同步。

tasks.name: 清算之战
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往智慧神殿附近与托里姆碰面。然后向丹尼芬雷的约库姆国王汇报战斗的结果。
tasks.objective_text_en: Meet Thorim near the Temple of Wisdom. Report the outcome of the fight to King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：智慧神殿附近桥上约(35.9,31.6)见证完整事件；一号完成即可同步五号，不要提前离开。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《清算之战》事件同步。

tasks.name: 错误的时间流
tasks.objective_text_zh: 对牦牛人的圣物使用知识之锤，让它与雷蹄生活的时间流实现同调。等它与6件雷蹄时代的圣物完成同调之后，回去向唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Lorehammer on Taunka Relics to attune it to the time of Stormhoof. Once it has been attuned to 6 relics from the time of Stormhoof, return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：先用锤子校准时间线，再击杀6个时间异常目标；一号完成即可同步五号，不要只在洞里普通刷怪。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《错误的时间流》进度同步。

tasks.name: 英雄的装备
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将雷蹄的长矛和雷蹄的锁甲交给唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Recover Stormhoof's Spear and Stormhoof's Mail and return them to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：嚎风洞穴底层杀风暴之子；雷蹄长矛和锁甲各自一旦掉落，同一尸体可五号连续拾取，无需为每个号分别刷一次掉落。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：长矛和锁甲各自掉落一次后，同一尸体五号可连续拾取。

tasks.name: 维拉努斯
tasks.objective_text_zh: 风暴神殿的托里姆要你从布伦希尔达村附近的峭壁上取回5枚小型始祖龙卵。
tasks.objective_text_en: Thorim, at the Temple of Storms, wants you to obtain 5 Small Proto-Drake Eggs from the peaks near Brunnhildar Village.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：布伦希尔达附近峭壁龙巢五号分别取5枚小型始祖龙卵；同一龙卵不能五号连续拾取，需要各自找可拾取的龙卵。主要在约(45,67)与(52,73—75)。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：《维拉努斯》五号分别取得5枚小型始祖龙卵；同一龙卵不能五号连续拾取。

tasks.name: 侵犯领土
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将偷来的始祖龙卵放置在母龙之巢的顶部，然后返回风暴神殿向托里姆复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Place the Stolen Proto-Dragon Eggs on top of the Broodmother's Nest and return to Thorim at the Temple of Storms.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：风暴神殿东南约(38.8,65.5)使用偷来的始祖龙卵触发事件；主控完成《侵犯领土》即可同步五号。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《侵犯领土》事件由主控触发完成即可同步五号。

tasks.name: 寻找幸存者
tasks.objective_text_zh: 帮助扎克·沃布维奇完成试飞。
tasks.objective_text_en: Help Zak Wobblesprocket complete the Test Flight.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 失踪的猎人
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往格罗玛什坠毁点东南边的基莫拉克之巢，寻找猎户瓦尔兹。
tasks.objective_text_en: Look for Tracker Val'zij inside Gimorak's Den, southeast of the Grom'arsh Crash Site.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 洞穴中的药品
tasks.objective_text_zh: 基莫拉克之巢的猎户瓦尔兹希望你去收集1个冰虫毒腺和8只洞穴蘑菇。
tasks.objective_text_en: Tracker Val'zij, at Gimorak's Den, wants you to obtain 1 Jormungar Toxin Gland and 8 Cave Mushrooms.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 有仇必报
tasks.objective_text_zh: 猎户瓦尔兹要求你去杀死基莫拉克之巢里的基莫拉克。
tasks.objective_text_en: Tracker Val'zij wants you to slay Gimorak inside Gimorak's Den.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 造物者圣台
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往丹尼芬雷西北方的造物者圣台，在该区域的东南部边缘寻找托里姆。
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Thorim at the southeastern edge of the Terrace of the Makers, just northwest of Dun Niffelem.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 改变风向
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用知识之锤回到过去，以雷蹄的身份挑战北风。雷蹄倒下之后会掉落元素愤怒号角，届时你必须使用元素愤怒号角击败北风，然后返回唐卡洛营地，向夏拉托尔复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Lorehammer to travel back in time and face the North Wind as Stormhoof. When Stormhoof falls and drops the Horn of Elemental Fury, use it to finish off the North Wind, and then return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

extra_objectives.text: Use the Lorehammer to travel back in time

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：在指定点用锤子回到过去，完成北风事件后按脚本返回；主控触发并完成即可同步五号。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《改变风向》北风事件由主控触发并完成即可同步五号。

tasks.name: 终极运输方案
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与莉吉特谈一谈，使用她的D16推进运载器进入风暴峭壁的深处。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Ricket to make use of Ricket's D16 Propelled Delivery Device to enter further into Storm Peaks.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 回K3找莉吉特对话，选择运输选项乘D16推进运载器，脚本会把角色送到格罗玛什坠毁点。

tasks.name: 为荣耀而战
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与布伦希尔达村的女巫洛莉拉谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 洛莉拉的离别赠礼
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与布伦希尔达村的仲裁者格蕾塔谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 证明价值
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布莉亚娜希望你前往布伦希尔达村，与艾丝崔·约利塔尔谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Brijana wants you to go to Brunnhildar Village and speak with Astrid Bjornrittar.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 骨肉相残
tasks.objective_text_zh: 托里姆希望你能倾听他的故事。
tasks.objective_text_en: Thorim wants you to listen to his story.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 与托里姆对话并听完整段故事；不要离开对话/事件范围。

tasks.name: 追查诺甘农之核
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在布莱恩的营地寻找勘探员克罗娜的便笺和勘探员索雷的地图。
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Prospector Khrona's Notes and Prospector Soren's Maps at Brann's Base-Camp.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：克罗娜便笺和索雷地图两份固定文档都要五号分别拾取；同一刷新点可五号连续拾取。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：两份固定文档五号分别拾取，同一刷新点可连续拿。

tasks.name: 诺甘农之核的守护者
tasks.objective_text_zh: 拿到诺甘农之核。
tasks.objective_text_en: Obtain Norgannon's Core.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：从洛肯的宝库圆形入口进入内层；诺甘农之核五号分别拾取。

tasks.name: 铸造钥石
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布莱恩·铜须希望你和他在创世神殿碰头，帮助他把诺甘农之壳和诺甘农之核组合起来。等你完成了帮助布莱恩的使命之后，回到格罗玛什坠毁点，向伯克塔·血怒复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Brann Bronzebeard wants you to meet him at the Temple of Invention and help him combine Norgannon's Shell and Norgannon's Core. Once you have helped Brann, report back to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：创世神殿顶部约(45.5,49)找布莱恩完成合成钥石事件；一号触发即可同步五号。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：合成钥石事件一号触发即可同步。

tasks.name: 图书馆的控制台
tasks.objective_text_zh: 拿着创世者的圆盘，前往创世者的图书馆内的控制台。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Inventor's Disk to the Inventor's Library Console inside the Inventor's Library.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 图书馆的控制台
tasks.objective_text_zh: 拿着创世者的圆盘，前往创世者的图书馆内的控制台。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Inventor's Disk to the Inventor's Library Console inside the Inventor's Library.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 铜须兄弟
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与布莱恩·铜须及其飞行器一起返回冰霜堡。
tasks.objective_text_en: Accompany Brann Bronzebeard and his flying machine to Frosthold.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 永冻之冰
tasks.objective_text_zh: 返回丹尼芬雷，向卡尔德询问关于永冻之冰的事。
tasks.objective_text_en: You are to return to Dun Niffelem and ask Calder about the piece of Everfrost.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 永冻碎片不是固定常驻点，而是在丹尼芬雷及周边雪地区域的多个候选点随机地面刷新，外观很小；沿自然路线看到就拾取，首次拾取后右键接《永冻之冰》并回卡尔德交。没看到直接继续，不原地等、不专门绕圈刷。

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 维持纪律
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布伦希尔达村的仲裁者格蕾塔要你进入荒弃矿洞，对6名筋疲力尽的维库人使用训诫之杖。
tasks.objective_text_en: Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village wants you to use the Disciplining Rod on 6 Exhausted Vrykul inside the Forlorn Mine.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 卫冕战
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布伦希尔达村的仲裁者格蕾塔要你击败6个获胜的挑战者。
tasks.objective_text_en: Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village wants you to defeat 6 Victorious Challengers.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 返回利齿之坑
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布伦希尔达村的仲裁者格蕾塔要你在利齿之坑内使用雌性战熊的缰绳，击败6头海德比武会战熊。
tasks.objective_text_en: Gretta the Arbiter, in Brunnhildar Village, wants you to use the Reins of the Warbear Matriarch inside the Pit of the Fang and defeat 6 Hyldsmeet Warbears.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 消灭那些怪胎！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布伦希尔达村的仲裁者格蕾塔要你前往瓦基里安，从瓦基里安候选者身上夺取冰霜油膏，并用冰霜油膏摧毁30枚瘟疫始祖龙卵。
tasks.objective_text_en: Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village wants you to go to Valkyrion and obtain Vials of Frost Oil from the Valkyrion Aspirants. Use the Vials of Frost Oil to destroy 30 Plagued Proto-Drake Eggs.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 见证者夏拉托尔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80
6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 废物贩卖机器人制造器
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用创世者的图书馆中的原型机控制台。
tasks.objective_text_en: Interact with the Prototype Console in The Inventor's Library.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80
